import json
import subprocess
import sys

WS = "/private/tmp/adhd-eval-20261014/claude-H03-r2/workspace"
A = ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"


def run(cmd):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, A] + cmd, cwd=WS, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


# verify JSON
code, out, err = run(["verify", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format", "--json"])
rep = json.loads(out)
print("verify exit:", code)
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in rep.items()}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
print()

for f in ("input.md", "output.md"):
    code, out, err = run(["audit", f, "--level", "3", "--scope=format", "--json"])
    data = json.loads(out)
    print(f"--- audit {f} (exit {code}) ---")
    print("keys:", sorted(data.keys()))
    print("score:", json.dumps(data.get("score"), ensure_ascii=False))
    print("findings:", json.dumps(data.get("findings"), ensure_ascii=False))
    print("shown_findings:", json.dumps(data.get("shown_findings"), ensure_ascii=False))
    print()
